entities.name: UserCompanyAnalyst
entities.rationale: Three stick figures on the left side representing internal NHS Digital teams who access the data access environment. Located outside (left of) the dashed line.

entities.name: EC2 Guacamole Gateway
entities.rationale: EC2 icon labeled 'EC2' on the left of the dashed vertical line; public gateway running Guacamole where users log in. Sits in the public side, outside the secure sandbox.

entities.name: AD Directory Service
entities.rationale: Green icon labeled 'AD' on the right side of the dashed line (secure sandbox); users authenticate via directory services.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'EMR' in the center, right of the dashed line (inside the secure sandbox); runs analytics jobs and reads data from S3.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'S3' on the right, inside the secure sandbox; stores datasets converted to Parquet, encrypted with KMS.

entities.name: KMS
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labeled 'KMS' at top right, inside the secure sandbox; provides the key to encrypt data in S3 and elsewhere.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: Blue icon labeled 'RDS' at top center, right of the dashed line (inside the secure sandbox); receives an arrow from KMS indicating encryption of its data. Not discussed explicitly in the transcript.

entities.name: EC2 Sandbox Instance
entities.rationale: Second EC2 icon labeled 'EC2' at bottom right, inside the secure sandbox (right of the dashed line); likely hosts data processing/analysis tooling (e.g. RStudio, JupyterHub, Hue); an arrow goes from it up to S3.

visual_connections.description: Green arrow from the users to the EC2 gateway; users log into Guacamole.

visual_connections.arrow_direction: EC2 Guacamole Gateway -> AD Directory Service
visual_connections.description: Curved green arrow from the gateway EC2 down and across the dashed line to AD; users authenticate via directory services.
Green arrow from EMR to S3; EMR reads the data from S3 for analytics jobs.
Curved green arrow from S3 up to the KMS box; S3 data is encrypted with a KMS key.
Curved green arrow from the KMS box towards RDS; other information in the system is also encrypted with KMS.
Curved green arrow from the bottom-right EC2 area up to S3; sandbox instance accesses data in S3.
